description: Discover enabled models and account-specific prices. Fetch only the selected model for its schema, or set includeSchema to reuse complete records without another model_get call. Returned input schemas are plain JSON Schema; display-only and rate-card annotations are removed. Some input values change the price; task_create obtains the exact request quote for confirmation. Use pricing entries for comparisons rather than calculating the accepted charge yourself. Models with task `realtime` or `realtime-transcription` take one bounded turn as a task from their input schema; live, continuous audio needs a server-side WebSocket to wss://api.spicyapi.ai/v1/realtime, which this server does not open. Embedding models (task `embedding`) and text-to-speech models are also served by OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/embeddings and POST /v1/audio/speech for applications that want vectors or audio bytes directly.
